title: Exercise-Adherence Streak After PT Plan Updates
dataSources: Pump telemetry (`health:glucose`), lab results (`health:lab`), therapy sessions (`health:pt`), symptom diaries (`health:symptom`), care tasks (`health:ops`).
app: Chronic-condition self-management telemetry — insulin-pump events, A1c lab imports, physical-therapy rep logs, and symptom diaries — streamed to Splunk HEC via device exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=health:pt plan_version=* streak_kept=*
| stats count as total, sum(eval(if(streak_kept="yes",1,0))) as matched by plan_version
| eval an_adherence_streak_kept_pct=round(100*matched/total,1)
| sort - an_adherence_streak_kept_pct
description: Measures the percentage of exercise streaks that end with an adherence streak kept by plan version.
value: Completion and exception percentages make it easier to spot which plan version are helping or hurting exercise streaks.
implementation: Store a normalized flag for `an adherence streak kept` on `health:pt` events and summarize the hit rate by `plan_version`.
visualization: Table of plan version with percentage of exercise streaks ending with an adherence streak kept.
grandmaExplanation: It celebrates how often an adherence streak kept happens for each plan version so you can see where exercise streaks go smoothly or get stuck.
